new_scholarship.description: The School of Graduate Studies of Universiti Putra Malaysia awards the International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS) as a 30-50% tuition fee waiver for PhD students from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa. Funding covers up to three years (to the sixth semester) and is subject to an annual review of the student's academic progress. Priority is given to applicants from developing countries where UPM holds strategic importance and to staff of institutions with an MoU or MoA with UPM. Applicants must hold a master's degree, must not hold any other scholarship or financial assistance, must not be employed at the time of application, and must supply a supervisor support letter and an embassy letter confirming they receive no government or agency financial assistance.

programme_detail_official.description: UPM's School of Graduate Studies awards the International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS) as a 30-50% tuition fee waiver for international PhD students from Southeast Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, the Middle East and Africa, for up to three years (sixth semester), subject to annual review of academic progress. Priority is given to applicants from developing countries where UPM holds strategic importance and to applicants from institutions with an MoU/MoA with UPM who intend to research in UPM priority areas. Applicants must hold a master's degree, hold no other scholarship or financial assistance, hold no employment at application, and provide a supervisor support letter together with an embassy letter confirming they receive no government or agency funding. Applications are made through the SGS student portal and require online endorsement by the applicant's supervisor and the dean/director of their faculty.
programme_detail_official.coverage: Partial tuition (30-50%) for up to 3 years of PhD study

application_readiness_checklist: Have the supervisor already agreed to support the application, since their online endorsement is required
Ask the faculty dean or director to endorse the application in the portal
Request the embassy letter early, as embassies can take weeks to issue it
Have at least one journal publication ready to evidence academic standing
Prepare a CV that shows no other scholarship, financial assistance or employment
common_rejection_risks: Missing the advisor or dean online endorsement, which cannot be added after the deadline
Holding another scholarship or any employment at the time of application
No journal publication and no strong institutional recommendation letters
Missing or late embassy verification letter
Applying from a country outside the stated regions
estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, accommodation and insurance, none of which are covered by this scheme
No airfare or travel grant is mentioned
document_audit: Passport and academic transcripts for the general international application
Embassy letter confirming no other funding
Journal publication PDF and recommendation letters

The embassy letter must confirm no other scholarship, grant or government income; holding GKS, MEXT or any other award at application invalidates eligibility.

submission_workflow: Register in the SGS student portal and open the IGSS application
Upload the required documents and request advisor/supervisor endorsement

Obtain the embassy verification letter and upload it before the deadline
Submit before the published closing date; late applications are not processed

new_scholarship.description: Asia Pacific University Malaysia offers international students tuition fee awards described as Merit Awards, which are fee awards leading to rebates or discounts. The published 2026/2027 table sets a 30% discount for AAA A-Levels, 8-9 O-Levels/IGCSE grades or IB Diploma 34 points and above, 20% for AAB, 6-7 O-Levels or IB 30-33 points, and 10% for ABB/AAC, 4-5 O-Levels or IB 26-29 points, with equivalent bands for IB MYP. The scheme applies to all nationalities, is awarded first come first served, and is renewable each year provided the student maintains a minimum CGPA of 2.50. The page publishes an application deadline heading but no date, so awards are treated as rolling.

programme_detail_official.description: APU Malaysia runs international student Scholarships & Merit Awards, which are tuition fee awards leading to rebates or discounts. The 2026/2027 table awards 30% for AAA A-Levels, 8-9 O-Levels/IGCSE grades, IB Diploma 34 points and above, or IB MYP 48 points and above; 20% for AAB, 6-7 O-Levels, IB 30-33 points or IB MYP 44-47 points; and 10% for ABB/AAC, 4-5 O-Levels, IB 26-29 points or IB MYP 35-43 points.
